<a id="mission"></a>

## Mission

You own u-a, ONE unit of plan 006-worktree-diff: the worktree LIFECYCLE DETECTOR. Today fs3 never notices that a git worktree of a registered repo appeared, and never notices that one vanished — both measured, see the probe report. Everything downstream already works: `add` scans a worktree for zero provider spend when its content matches main (305 files, 0 elements, 0 summaries, 0 vectors, 0 provider round trips), and `remove` + `gc` dereference and reclaim it cleanly with zero orphaned paid enrichment (149 elements + 8 vectors reclaimed). You are building the DETECTOR, not the mechanism: one reconcile pass that diffs the live worktrees of registered repos against the `worktrees` table and drives the EXISTING roots.rs verbs at both ends.

| i9 | THE DESIGN, settled — fill this contract, do not widen it. A `Reconcile` implementor (same trait `WatcherSupervisor` and `GcSupervisor` use) in crates/daemon/src/worktrees.rs, registered in the boot.rs roster with ONE line. Each pass: enumerate the live git worktrees of every registered repo, diff against the `worktrees` table, then (a) for each that appeared, drive the EXISTING registration+scan path; (b) for each whose directory is gone, drive the EXISTING remove path. Reclamation stays GC's on GC's cadence — you never delete content, and you never invent a second reference mechanism beside roots.rs (plan risk r2, and the review will look for it by name). |
| i10 | PRIME'S RIDER, binding on your done bar: the detector may pay O(files) on the FIRST registration of a worktree, and must NOT re-emit that work on later passes for an unchanged worktree. Measured baseline: one 305-file registration emits 4,767 jobs, of which 4,462 are enrichment jobs that store nothing (free in spend, deliberate re-emission, but O(files)). Five live worktrees on this machine would mean ~24k no-op jobs per sweep. A diff-only pass gets this for free — but PROVE it, do not assert it: add one line to assets/probes/probe.sh that runs repeated passes over an unchanged registered worktree and records the jobs enqueued (expected: 0). |
| i11 | DONE IS MECHANICAL — the probe harness is your test. Re-running docs/plans/006-worktree-diff/assets/probes/probe.sh must flip `p1_auto_discovered` 0 -&gt; 1 and `p4_root_still_registered` 1 -&gt; 0 in receipt.env WITHOUT any manual CLI call, with `p4_served_after_gc` still 0 and your new no-op line reading 0. That is on top of, not instead of, standalone offline unit tests with fakes (mocking crates are refused by name in this repo) and `harness checks` green in your own worktree. |
| i12 | TEST CONSTRAINT (DL-002, binding): never assert on raw search scores. They carry float jitter across identical calls — 0.7730240968 vs 0.7730564295 for the same query seconds apart — and it already produced one phantom finding in phase 1. Compare result identity (address/path/name/kind/span) or rank order. |
| i13 | Your pij sends from this worktree need PIJ_SESSION_ID exported. Status card at start and end of the unit (`pij report now "&lt;did&gt;" "&lt;next&gt;"`). Report to the PM (pij-parliamentary-leopon), never to prime or Jordan. |
